patches.purpose: Compile out stdout, filesystem-backed loaders, dynamic source loading, and guest GC controls from the base registration table.
Route z8lua @/%/$ through the project-owned 16-bit, bytewise Pico address mapper instead of the upstream lower-32-KiB flat reader.

Preserve PICO-8 short-if semantics across swallowed long comments; accept conditional do, return-question print, single-token XOR, single-name local compound initialization and omitted argument slots; and fall back from local or captured replacement environments to original cart globals.
tests: tests/runtime/real-cart-gaps.test.mjs: omitted argument and original environment regressions
tests/runtime/lua-language.test.mjs: parser dialect and local environment regressions

patches.purpose: Compute the next Q16.16 numeric-for index without signed C++ overflow and terminate at either representable numeric boundary instead of wrapping indefinitely.
tests: tests/runtime/timing-compat.test.mjs: finite heavy work and Q16.16 boundary loop

policy: Ordered patches are applied to the vendored snapshot and must remain minimal, reviewable, and covered by named conformance tests.
